metadata.notes: The diameter is Ø1220 mm: the table is reduced so that the robot stays 0.550 m away. The workbook value (Ø1520) is kept and only the authoring applies the reduction; the height 740, the circular planform, the tablecloth rules and the rest of the contract do not change. If the workbook is revised, the reduction layer is removed and the asset rebuilt. Collision disc radius 610.0 mm, 192 polygon segments. The tablecloth's top is fixed as one plane on the top, with no wrinkles or lift (over all 6529 top vertices the measured gap is 0.2 mm minimum and 0.2 mm maximum, 0 edge penetrations). Only the skirt below the edge is draped by a deterministic cloth simulation in the pipeline and frozen at a fixed frame; it is visual only. 3 collision pieces.
